Name: Asterisk's Alternative Textures Tools Retexture
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Changes the way the tools used in the Alternatives Textures framework look
Description:
_Description_

*   Simple mod that changes the way the tools used in the Alternatives Textures framework look.

*   I based the scissor sprite on ones for left handed people since the world needs more of those and I made them closed because you shouldn't run with open scissors kids.

*   If you like this I do art commissions feel free to message me.
_To Use_

*   To use just unzip into your mods folder.

*   You can buy the tools in Robin's Carpenter shop and then you just click on whatever you want to change while the tool is selected.
I recommend using [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) if you like being able to change your config options without relaunching the game. For more information on what Alternative Texture is [click here](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246).

_Config options_

*   PaintBucket: true, false

*   PaintBrush_Empty: true, false

*   PaintBrush_Filled: true, false

*   Scissors: Blue, Lefty, False
_Compatibility_

*   Should only conflict with other mods that also specifically change the way the tools in Alternative Textures look, and a config file is included so you can switch individual tool retextures off by typing in "false". All are set to "true" by default.

*   [Hojichas Seaside Furniture and Wallpapers and Floors for Alternative Textures](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9852)

*   And personal conversions to AT of [Solip's coop animals](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8088)﻿, [Elle's New Coop Animals](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8088)﻿﻿, [Farm Animal Facelift](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057)﻿, [Eemie's Animals for BFAV](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/688256-eemies-animals-for-bfav)﻿, and a few other mods including those from Nexus, Naver and some personal edits.
